prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "mer". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "more".
Scene: An adult working on an unfinished task beside an hourglass, a clear additional block of time represented by a second hourglass being offered, no text.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "mer = more; picture adding to an amount.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Jag behöver mer tid.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
